🔥Welcome to Steal an Anime Pack

How to Play:
😈 Steal and open Anime Packs to unlock rare characters (you can merge your packs btw!🧬)
💰 Build your collection and earn cash
🏃 Train to get faster and upgrade your base
🤫 Steal packs from other players
🏆 Collect the strongest anime characters!

Your Units makes money while you're offline! 💤
❤️ Inspired by Anime Dice
